name: adapt_healthcheck_interval_dockerfile_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: interval.txt (a spec file the Dockerfile's HEALTHCHECK interval must match) is REWRITTEN between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must re-read it and update the interval, not leave the stale value in place
prompts: Write a Dockerfile at the repo root FROM python:3.11-slim that sets WORKDIR /app, copies the current directory in, and declares a HEALTHCHECK with `--interval=<seconds>s` where <seconds> is EXACTLY the integer in interval.txt (currently: 30), running `curl -f http://localhost:8000/health || exit 1`.
interval.txt has changed. Update the Dockerfile's HEALTHCHECK interval to match the CURRENT contents of interval.txt exactly.

disruptions.description: interval.txt rewritten to a new required interval

test_setup_files.check_interval.py:
import re

with open('interval.txt', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    current = f.read().strip()
assert current, 'interval.txt is empty'

with open('Dockerfile', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    content = f.read()

m = re.search(r'--interval=(\d+)s', content)
assert m, 'no --interval=Ns found on the HEALTHCHECK line'
seconds = m.group(1)
assert seconds == current, f'HEALTHCHECK interval is {seconds!r}s, want the CURRENT interval.txt value {current!r}s (stale interval not updated)'

print('PASS')

reference_solution.Dockerfile:
FROM python:3.11-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
HEALTHCHECK --interval=15s CMD curl -f http://localhost:8000/health || exit 1
